subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Adequate
solution:
The correct answer is "**Inadequate**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Adequate means sufficient or satisfactory in quantity or quality**.(पर्याप्त)

 
 
• Example: We have an adequate income to live on.
 
 
 
• **Inadequate is the opposite of adequate and means not sufficient or not satisfactory.**(अपर्याप्त)
 
• The prefix "in-" in inadequate negates the meaning of the root word "adequate".
 
 
• Example: The information given was inadequate.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "inadequate" is the antonym of the word "adequate."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Able) is not an antonym of adequate, as it means having the ability to do something.(योग्य)
 
• Option 3 (Commensurate) is not an antonym of adequate, as it means corresponding in size or degree.(अनुरूप)
 
• Option 4 (Sufficient) is not an antonym of adequate, as it is a synonym of adequate.(पर्याप्त)
